subject: Change request: mapping order form scope + tiered fees
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@vivacare.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vivacare.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: update order form mapping + tier reclassification

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We reviewed the order form with our procurement team and we need a short change request so the order maps throughput tiers differently across our feature bundles. Specifically:

- Move 200k tokens/mo from Tier B into Tier A for the Diagnosis feature set.
- Add a separate line for ephemeral burst capacity (50k tokens) during onboarding.
- Clarify acceptance criteria for the SOW Exhibit A (we need explicit latency and throughput gates).

I've attached our suggested markup (VivaCare_OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx) — it contains inline comments on fee impact. Can you confirm whether this requires a change order or a new SOW exhibit? Also flag any billing/pricing implications.

We'd like to close this mid-Jan if possible.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
VivaCare Health
Attachment: VivaCare_OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (docx)

-----Original Message Follows-----

Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: update order form mapping + tier reclassification

Elena — thank you for the clear summary and the redlines. We can handle this as a single Change Order (Order Form Amendment) with an updated Exhibit A for SOW acceptance criteria. Next steps from our side:

1) Ops review: Karthik, can you confirm whether the Tier move + burst pool requires provisioning lead time or a one-time migration fee?
2) Legal review: Stephanie, please confirm any MSA language we should touch (rollback, acceptance gates, and fee timing).
3) Commercial: Laura, I'll need you to run fee-impact and create a DocuSign amendment packet once we align.

Proposing a 30-minute sync on Wednesday 14th (10:30 PT) to align technical vs pricing risk — ok for everyone?

I'll hold on formal response to Elena until we have Karthik + Stephanie's input.

—Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

On Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:47:00 -0800, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> Grace / Laura,
>
> Quick ops notes after reviewing Elena's redlines:
>
> - Moving 200k tokens from Tier B -> Tier A for the Diagnosis feature is operationally straightforward; no additional nodes required, but we will need to re-tag quota allocations in the customer account. Estimated ops work: 2 engineer-hours + 1 admin-hour.
> - Burst pool (50k tokens) during onboarding is feasible but we recommend it be implemented as a timeboxed credit rather than persistent SKU.
> - One-time migration handling: we recommend a migration fee to cover manual re-tagging and validation. Ballpark: USD 1,200. If commercial approves a credit, we can bake that into the change order.
>
> Impact to timeline: if we approve this week, provisioning and validation can complete in 5 business days. If Elena wants acceptance gates added to SOW Exhibit A, provide the exact metrics and we will instrument checks internally.
>
> Karthik
> Sr. Ops Engineer, Redwood Inference
>
On Thu, 15 Jan 2026 10:22:00 -0800, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi all,
>
> Legal review notes on the proposed redlines (high level):
>
> 1) MSA & Order Form: this is a commercial change to Order Form pricing and scope — treat as a Change Order executed under existing MSA. No need for new MSA unless new data handling requirements arise.
> 2) Acceptance criteria: we should add a short exhibit describing acceptance tests and an explicit sign-off owner on the customer side. Avoid embedding overly prescriptive SLOs in the SOW; prefer measurable test steps (e.g., sample prompt set with latency measured at 95th percentile).
> 3) Rollback & credits: propose explicit rollback language (30-day notice window) and codify one-time migration credit (if commercial agrees) as a credit memo tied to the change order.
>
> I've attached a redlined Order Form with suggested language and a proposed Exhibit A template for acceptance tests (SOW-exhibit-A-prop.pdf). Key outstanding items: (a) confirm migration credit amount, (b) confirm whether burst pool will be billed as consumed or prepaid.
>
> I'll need procurement countersignature fields preserved for DocuSign.
>
> Regards,
> Stephanie Nguyen
> Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
> Attachment: SOW-exhibit-A-prop.pdf (pdf)
>
> On Thu, Jan 15, 2026 at 10:22 AM Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Inline: added placeholders where customer must insert acceptance owner and sample prompt set.
>

From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@vivacare.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@vivacare.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Jan 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: update order form mapping + tier reclassification

Thanks, everyone. The team reviewed Stephanie's notes and we are comfortable with the Change Order approach and the proposed Exhibit A template. Two commercial asks before we sign:

- Can Redwood provide a one-time migration credit? Our vendor migration budget is limited; a 10% credit on the first-month fees would help close approval.
- Burst pool billing: we prefer the burst to be a prepaid credit applied to onboarding month (not billed as consumed).

If those two items are acceptable, we'll return a countersigned Change Order by EOD Wednesday.

Best,
Elena

On Tue, 20 Jan 2026 15:02:00 -0800, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elena — quick update and proposal from Redwood:
>
> - Migration credit: we can provide a one-time 10% credit on the first month fee for the affected SKUs (applies only to non-recurring migration fee and first-month consumption).
> - Burst pool: we'll model as a prepaid onboarding credit (50k tokens) applied to the first invoice.
> - Acceptance criteria: Stephanie's Exhibit A will be included. Laura will produce an amendment (Change Order) and a DocuSign packet with the redlined Order Form attached.
>
> Laura — please prepare the amendment reflecting the credit and the prepaid burst, and include the Exhibit A template. Send to Elena's DocuSign address (elena.morales@vivacare.com) and cc: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com. Target: send packet by close of day tomorrow (21 Jan).
>
> Elena — please confirm so we can finalize DocuSign flow. Once countersigned we will schedule provisioning; expected completion 5 business days from effective date.
>
> Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the finish line.
>
> Best,
>Grace O'Connor
>Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
